commands.label: initialize
commands.preludeTemplate: Use the initialize operation template. Read {projectPath}/.hagicode/monospecs.yaml; if missing, create .hagicode/ and the minimal version/commit_when_archive/repositories configuration; if valid, preserve it and report no overwrite; if invalid, stop and report the exact error. Validate before writing and report the path, repository count, and final state. User instructions: {operationDescription}

commands.label: add-repository
commands.preludeTemplate: Use the add-repository operation template. Read and validate {projectPath}/.hagicode/monospecs.yaml, extract one or more absolute URLs, infer path/displayName/icon/tags, reject invalid URLs and normalized duplicate paths, append in input order, revalidate the full document, then write or report that nothing changed. User instructions: {operationDescription}

commands.label: reorder-repositories
commands.preludeTemplate: Use the reorder-repositories operation template. Read repository activity signals, put commonly used repositories first with ui.collapseToMore=false, put low-frequency repositories later with ui.collapseToMore=true, show a position and More-group preview with evidence, wait for explicit confirmation, then change only array order and ui.collapseToMore and revalidate; without confirmation or on failure, do not write. User instructions: {operationDescription}
